title: Light Blue Account — summary
summary: This document describes the Light Blue Account’s key costs: $0.00 monthly maintenance fee, $0.00 overdraft fee, and a $10 cashier’s check fee per check. It explains that no overdraft fee applies when the balance goes negative and that each cashier’s check is issued for a $10 cost.
